cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Consequences Compound
cards.instruction: Make each new choice carry a larger reward, cost, audience, or point of no return.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Choose the biscuits for the new committee's first meeting. I taught you to check the plate before guests arrive; no broken ones this time.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've remembered to feed people, at least. Now choose what they'll remember about our welcome. Your plate goes beside the chair's speech.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They won't care which biscuits I pick.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then put your name beside them and let the chair thank you in the speech. Write it neatly, as I taught you; the whole room will know whose choice they're eating.
